quickened_blood.name: Quickened Blood
quickened_blood.description: Your first turn in each combat has 1 extra @icon(card_play).

lantern_sight.name: Lantern Sight
lantern_sight.description: Start each combat with 3 turns of @icon(vision).

hunted.name: Hunted
hunted.description: Each combat has one more enemy.

leaden_limbs.name: Leaden Limbs
leaden_limbs.description: Your first turn in each combat has 1 less @icon(move).

deepening_dark.name: Deepening Dark
deepening_dark.description: The @icon(umbra) is one stage deeper in each combat.

lost_cartographer.title: The Lost Cartographer
lost_cartographer.body: A mapmaker sits against the wall, quill still in hand, dead a week or a century. His charts are pinned beneath a purse heavy with Embers. The ink on the top sheet is still wet.

choices.label: Take the purse
choices.result: The Embers are warm. You do not look at the wet ink again.

choices.label: Study the charts
choices.result: The routes ahead unfold in his careful hand. One of them, you notice, ends at a drawing of you.

bloodletters_basin.title: The Bloodletter's Basin
bloodletters_basin.body: A basin of black stone stands in an alcove, its lip worn smooth by kneeling. Dried runnels stain the floor beneath it. Something glints at the bottom, and something deeper still is thirsty.

choices.label: Bleed into the basin
choices.result: The basin drinks. When it is done, it gives back what it was guarding.

choices.label: Reach in
choices.result: Something closes on your fingers, but not quite fast enough.

ossuary_gamblers.title: The Ossuary Gamblers
ossuary_gamblers.body: Three skeletons crouch around an upturned shield, rattling knucklebones in a skull. The bones have no marks left on them. An empty place has been left in their circle, and they will play for whatever you put down.

choices.label: Stake 50 Embers
choices.result: The bones always fall the same way. One of them slides a dented piece of kit across the shield and tucks your Embers into its ribcage.

choices.label: Stake a little of yourself
choices.result: You win something they had been keeping a long time. They clack approvingly at what you lost to get it.

hanged_knight.title: The Hanged Knight
hanged_knight.body: A knight in good armour turns slowly on a chain above a pit. The chain groans with every turn, loud enough to carry far down the halls.

choices.label: Cut him down
choices.result: He comes down with a crash that echoes for a long time. His gear is yours. So is everything that heard.

choices.label: Take what you can reach
choices.result: You work his boots free with the tip of your blade. He does not object.

whispering_well.title: The Whispering Well
whispering_well.body: Voices rise from a dry well, your own among them, saying things you have not said yet. A bucket hangs ready on its rope. Far below, black water lies very still.

choices.label: Drink
choices.result: It tastes of iron and cold stone. Your wounds close. The voices do not stop.

choices.label: Drop an Ember in
choices.result: The Ember falls a long way. Something at the bottom whispers a spell back up to you.

weeping_statue.title: The Weeping Statue
weeping_statue.body: A stone saint weeps from a single eye. The other socket holds a gem the size of a fist, glowing faintly against the dark.

choices.label: Pry out the gem
choices.result: The gem comes free. The light goes with it, and the dark leans closer for a while.

choices.label: Pray beneath her
choices.result: Her tears fall on your brow. They are warm.

name_collector.title: The Collector of Names
name_collector.body: A tall figure in a coat of stitched parchment bows to you. Every scrap of the coat bears a name. "Give me yours," it says, "and I will keep it safe from the dark."

choices.label: Give your name
choices.result: It writes your name on its sleeve with a careful hand. You feel lighter, and somewhat less.

choices.label: Give a false name
choices.result: It pays you anyway. A name is a name. Somewhere in the dark, something learns you lied.

moth_library.title: The Moth-Eaten Library
moth_library.body: Shelves of rotting books lean into one another. Most crumble at a touch, but a few still hold their spells, pressed between the pages like dried flowers.

choices.label: Search the shelves
choices.result: Three spells survive your searching.

choices.label: Burn them for warmth
choices.result: The old words burn bright and briefly. You sleep an hour beside them.

starving_pilgrim.title: The Starving Pilgrim
starving_pilgrim.body: A pilgrim kneels in the dust, too weak to stand. His hands are cupped as if in prayer, but they are only begging. An offering bowl sits untouched at his knees.

choices.label: Give him an item
choices.result: He eats with shaking hands, then presses his palm to your chest and whispers a blessing. It settles in your bones.

choices.label: Give him Embers
choices.result: He weeps over their warmth and swears the dark will repay you.

choices.label: Take his offering bowl
choices.result: He does not resist. You will remember that he did not resist.

abandoned_forge.title: The Abandoned Forge
abandoned_forge.body: The forge is cold, but the anvil is not. Someone was working here very recently and left in a hurry. Their tools are laid out in perfect order.

choices.label: Reforge your weapon
choices.result: The anvil remembers the work. Your weapon comes out of the quench better than it went in. Your hands come out burnt.

choices.label: Reforge your armour
choices.result: You beat out the dents and fold in something new. It fits better than it did.

shrine_last_door.title: Shrine of the Last Door
shrine_last_door.body: A door stands alone in the middle of the hall, framed by nothing. Candles burn along its threshold. Those who pass through it, the pilgrims say, come back.

choices.label: Kneel at the threshold
choices.result: The candles gutter. When they steady, you know you have one more door to walk through.

choices.label: Take a candle
choices.result: It burns without wax, and its warmth stays with you.

fallen_lantern_bearer.title: The Fallen Lantern-Bearer
fallen_lantern_bearer.body: A guide lies where the dark caught him, his lantern still burning in his fist. His satchel has spilled across the floor.

choices.label: Take his lantern
choices.result: His grip opens easily, as if he had been waiting to hand it on.

choices.label: Search the satchel
choices.result: Oil, a charm, a roll of clean bandage. He packed well.

mirror_of_skins.title: The Mirror of Second Skins
mirror_of_skins.body: Your reflection in the tall mirror moves half a step late, and it wears your spells differently than you do. It lays one palm flat against the glass.

choices.label: Take its hand
choices.result: For a moment you stand on the wrong side of the glass. When you step back, one of your spells has changed.

choices.label: Let it choose for you
choices.result: Your reflection sorts through your spells like a gambler through cards.

choices.label: Shatter the glass
choices.result: The silver backing is worth something to someone. The crash carries, and something answers it.

sealed_sarcophagus.title: The Breathing Sarcophagus
sealed_sarcophagus.body: A sarcophagus lies open a finger's width. From inside comes slow, even breathing, and the faint gleam of treasure.

choices.label: Push the lid open
choices.result: The breathing stops. The treasure stays. Whatever was breathing has had a good look at you.

choices.label: Reach through the gap
choices.result: Something nips your wrist as you draw back. You keep what you grabbed.

ember_usurer.title: The Ember Usurer
ember_usurer.body: A hunched merchant squats on a heap of coals, counting Embers that are not his. "Borrow now," he purrs, "and repay as you go."

choices.label: Borrow
choices.result: The Embers are hot in your hand. The debt is colder.

choices.label: Buy from his coat
choices.result: He sells you a trinket from deep in his coat and counts your Embers twice.

petrified_pilgrims.title: The Petrified Pilgrims
petrified_pilgrims.body: A whole procession stands frozen in stone mid-stride, purses still at their belts. Grit trickles from the ceiling. The Worldspine is restless here.

choices.label: Chip their purses free
choices.result: Stone purses, stone coins, but the Embers inside are real. A falling shard opens your cheek.

choices.label: Touch the foremost pilgrim
choices.result: The stone creeps a little way up your fingers and stays. It does not hurt. It does not leave.

root_choked_vault.title: The Root-Choked Vault
root_choked_vault.body: Roots as thick as a man's waist have split a vault door from its hinges. Through the gap you can see gear stacked in the dark, and the roots are still growing.

choices.label: Tear through the roots
choices.result: The roots fight back. You win.

choices.label: Squeeze through the gap
choices.result: You come out with something, and with most of your skin.

cinder_supplicant.title: The Cinder Supplicant
cinder_supplicant.body: A robed figure kneels before a brazier, feeding it with its own fingers. It has very few left. "The Crown hungers," it says. "Feed it, and it teaches."

choices.label: Offer your hand
choices.result: The flame takes its due. In return it shows you three ways to burn.

choices.label: Feed it Embers
choices.result: The brazier swallows your Embers and spits back a spell.

ember_font.title: The Ember Font
ember_font.body: A pool of molten ember seethes in a ring of black glass. Weapons have been plunged into it and abandoned, their hilts blackened, their blades gone strange.

choices.label: Quench your weapon
choices.result: The metal drinks the fire and keeps some for itself. So do you.

choices.label: Pull a blade from the font
choices.result: The hilt is very hot. You hold on.

bell_of_the_gale.title: The Bell of the Gale
bell_of_the_gale.body: A great bronze bell hangs in an open arch over nothing. The wind rings it now and then, and the halls answer with movement.

choices.label: Ring it
choices.result: The note goes through you and keeps going. Your blood runs faster. So does everything that heard.

choices.label: Strip its bronze
choices.result: You pry away what you can carry. The bell falls silent, and the wind with it.

windcut_bridge.title: The Wind-Cut Bridge
windcut_bridge.body: A rope bridge spans a chasm, the wind pulling at it like a hand at a loose thread. On the far side, a corpse has left its pack.

choices.label: Run across
choices.result: You reach the pack before the wind reaches you. Most of you, anyway.

choices.label: Crawl across
choices.result: Slow, scraped and safe. Most of the pack went over the edge before you got there.

frozen_champion.title: The Frozen Champion
frozen_champion.body: A champion stands sealed in clear ice, her blade raised against something that never arrived. Her eyes follow you across the room.

choices.label: Shatter the ice
choices.result: The ice breaks like a shout. She falls into a thousand pieces. Her sword does not.

choices.label: Thaw her with Embers
choices.result: She lives for three breaths, long enough to press her hand to your chest and pass something on.

hoarfrost_spring.title: The Hoarfrost Spring
hoarfrost_spring.body: Steam rises from a spring in the ice, though the water is bitter cold. Bones rest on the bottom, picked clean and very peaceful.

choices.label: Bathe
choices.result: The cold closes your wounds and settles into your joints.

choices.label: Fill a flask
choices.result: It never warms.

storm_obelisk.title: The Storm-Struck Obelisk
storm_obelisk.body: An obelisk of fused glass hums in the middle of a scorched circle. Every few breaths, lightning crawls up its length and something inside it lights up.

choices.label: Grasp it
choices.result: The storm passes through you and leaves something behind, along with the burn.

choices.label: Chip a shard loose
choices.result: It bites you on the way out, but it comes.

tempest_choir.title: The Tempest Choir
tempest_choir.body: Bell-tenders in tattered robes sing up at the storm. When they see you, they open a space in their circle and keep singing.

choices.label: Join the hymn
choices.result: The song is mostly thunder. You learn the words anyway.

choices.label: Rob the collection plate
choices.result: The singing stops.

umbral_bargain.title: The Umbral Bargain
umbral_bargain.body: The dark in this room is thicker than elsewhere, and it is listening. When you speak, it answers in your own voice. "You want to leave," it says. "I can help."

choices.label: Accept
choices.result: It gives you exactly what you asked for. It takes exactly what it was owed.

choices.label: Haggle
choices.result: It laughs with your laugh. The price is smaller. So is the gift.

your_own_body.title: Your Own Body
your_own_body.body: A body lies face-down in the dust, wearing your clothes and carrying your gear, one hand outstretched toward the way you came. You do not turn it over.

choices.label: Search it
choices.result: Everything in its pockets is familiar. Some of it is still warm.

choices.label: Bury it
choices.result: It takes a long time with bare hands. When you are done, you feel harder to kill.

toll_collector.title: The Toll Collector
toll_collector.body: A hooded figure sits on a stool in the middle of the corridor, a lockbox between its knees. There is no bridge and no gate. It holds out one hand anyway.

choices.label: Pay the toll
choices.result: It stamps your wrist with something warm. The next few doors open easier.

choices.label: Take the lockbox
choices.result: It doesn't stop you. It stands, folds the stool and follows at a distance.

drowned_chapel.title: The Drowned Chapel
drowned_chapel.body: Black water fills the nave to your knees. At the altar, under the surface, a reliquary glows. The water is very cold and very still, and it remembers everyone who has stood in it.

choices.label: Wade to the altar
choices.result: You come back with the reliquary. The cold comes back with you, and it stays in your legs.

choices.label: Wash your wounds
choices.result: The wounds close. The chapel is darker when you look up, and so is everywhere after it.

patient_surgeon.title: The Patient Surgeon
patient_surgeon.body: A surgeon in a beaked mask has laid out his tools on a clean cloth. "You look unwell," he says, "and I am short of blood. I expect we can help each other." There is a chair. It has straps.

choices.label: Pay for stitches
choices.result: He is very good. You try not to think about where he practised.

choices.label: Sell him a pint
choices.result: He counts out the Embers with wet fingers and thanks you for your patience.

twin_doors.title: The Twin Doors
twin_doors.body: Two doors stand side by side in a wall that should not have any. One is warm to the touch. One is not. A note nailed between them reads ONE OF THESE IS A MISTAKE, in your own handwriting.

choices.label: The warm door
choices.result: Behind it, a smithy on fire and a piece of gear left on the anvil. The heat follows you out.

choices.label: The cold door
choices.result: Behind it, a study, frost on the pages, and a chair turned to face the door. You read quickly.

tinkers_cart.title: The Tinker's Cart
tinkers_cart.body: A tinker's cart stands in the passage with no tinker anywhere near it. A painted sign says TAKE ONE, LEAVE ONE. The shelves hold other people's gear, some of it still warm.

choices.label: Leave something, take one
choices.result: You put yours on the shelf and take the better one. It seems fair, and that worries you.

choices.label: Just take one
choices.result: You walk away quickly. Behind you, a wheel begins to turn.

candle_auction.title: The Candle Auction
candle_auction.body: Hooded bidders sit in rows. An auctioneer holds up a lot you cannot quite see while a candle burns down on the lectern. You find a numbered paddle in your hand, and you do not remember taking it.

choices.label: Bid high
choices.result: Nobody bids against you. Nobody looks at you either, as you carry it out.

choices.label: Bid low
choices.result: The candle gutters out just in time. The room sighs, and you are handed a small parcel.

choices.label: Sell your paddle
choices.result: The bidder beside you pays without turning its head. You did not see it take the paddle.

the_sleeper.title: The Sleeper
the_sleeper.body: Something the size of a house sleeps across the passage, ribs rising and falling like slow bellows. The way around will take hours. Its purse lies open on the floor, close enough to reach.

choices.label: Cut its purse
choices.result: It doesn't wake. One eye opens anyway, and it follows you all the way out.

choices.label: Take the long way
choices.result: It takes hours. You learn a great deal about these halls, and nothing at all about what it was.

ash_confessional.title: The Ash Confessional
ash_confessional.body: A booth of charred wood stands alone in the dark. From behind the screen, a voice says, "Tell me what you have done, and I will take it from you." It sounds as if it means it.

choices.label: Confess a little
choices.result: You feel lighter. One of your spells no longer works quite the way you remember.

choices.label: Confess everything
choices.result: It takes a long time. It takes a good deal more than you offered.

last_expedition.title: The Last Expedition
last_expedition.body: Another like you sits slumped against the wall, breathing wet and shallow. Their gear is better than yours. They look at it, then at you, and say nothing at all.

choices.label: Take their gear
choices.result: They watch you do it. They are still watching when you look back from the end of the hall.

choices.label: Sit with them
choices.result: You stay until it is over. You leave with nothing in your hands, and you walk faster than you came.

hungry_door.title: The Hungry Door
hungry_door.body: The door has a mouth where the lock should be. It is small and patient, and it has waited a long while. From beyond it comes the sound of coins settling.

choices.label: Feed it something
choices.result: It swallows, considers and opens. You take what you can carry.

choices.label: Feed it your blood
choices.result: It drinks and drinks, then lets you in. The coins are warm.

ember_shaft.title: The Ember Shaft
ember_shaft.body: A shaft drops away into the dark with warm air rising from it. Far below, a bed of Embers pulses like something breathing. A frayed rope hangs down. It looks long enough.

choices.label: Climb down
choices.result: The rope holds until you are nearly back up. Your pockets are full, and you stop bleeding eventually.

choices.label: Throw one in
choices.result: It falls for a long time. Below, the bed brightens, and the dark seems to owe you something.

blind_scribe.title: The Blind Scribe
blind_scribe.body: An old scribe writes without ink in a book that is almost full. He turns his head as you come near. "Yours is a short chapter," he says. "I could make it longer, or I could make it better."

choices.label: Make it longer
choices.result: His pen scratches on. You feel sturdier, and the halls feel longer and darker for it.

choices.label: Make it better
choices.result: He crosses out a line and writes a finer one. You miss whatever was on it.

quarry_mouth.title: The Quarry's Mouth
quarry_mouth.body: A quarry has been cut into the living rock, its tools abandoned mid-stroke. The stone at the face is warm and soft as bread. It closes slowly over anything left touching it.

choices.label: Dig out the seam
choices.result: The stone grips your arms to the elbow before it gives up what it was keeping.

choices.label: Press your skin to it
choices.result: It takes a thin layer of you, and leaves a thin layer of itself.

kiln_of_names.title: The Kiln of Names
kiln_of_names.body: A kiln the height of a chapel burns with nobody tending it. Clay figures line its shelves, each with a face you nearly know. One of them is shaped like you, and it has not been fired.

choices.label: Fire it
choices.result: You slide yourself into the heat and feel it set. You are harder now, and you run hot.

choices.label: Smash it
choices.result: Something inside you cracks with it. Between the shards, the kiln has left you a choice.

howling_gallery.title: The Howling Gallery
howling_gallery.body: A long gallery of slit windows sings as the wind crosses it, every window a different note. Stop your ears and you can cross in peace. Listen, and the song tells you things you may not want.

choices.label: Listen
choices.result: By the far end you know the song, and it knows you.

choices.label: Stop your ears
choices.result: You cross in silence, counting the windows, and you see the routes beyond them plainly.

glass_lake.title: The Glass Lake
glass_lake.body: Beneath the ice a procession walks the lake bed, lanterns lit, faces upturned. One of them carries gear you would like very much. The ice is thin above it, and the procession has noticed you.

choices.label: Break the ice
choices.result: An arm comes up and hands it to you. The cold takes your legs for its trouble.

choices.label: Bow to them
choices.result: They bow back and raise their lanterns, and for a while you can see further than you should.

copper_saint.title: The Copper Saint
copper_saint.body: A copper saint stands in a flooded crypt, arms raised, struck so many times that the metal has run like wax. Sparks walk the water toward your boots. Its halo looks loose.

choices.label: Take the halo
choices.result: It comes away in your hand. So does most of the feeling in that hand, for a while.

choices.label: Stand in the water
choices.result: It finds you. When the ringing stops, your heart is going twice as fast.

last_hearth.title: The Last Hearth
last_hearth.body: A hearth burns in the dark with nobody beside it, and for the first time in a long while you are warm. You could stay. Everyone here stayed, you realise, looking at the shapes around the fire.

choices.label: Warm your hands
choices.result: It is the best you have felt in days. It is much darker when you finally stand.

choices.label: Take a coal
choices.result: It burns through everything you wrap it in. You carry it anyway.
